create_coco_annotation: create a COCO annotation dict from a binary mask, bounding box, and object id
convert_mask_to_polygon: convert a binary mask to COCO polygon representation with configurable tolerance
convert_mask_to_rle: convert a binary mask to COCO run-length encoding format for compact storage
decode_rle_to_mask: decode a COCO run-length encoded mask back into a 2D binary numpy array
merge_coco_annotations: merge two COCO annotation dicts by concatenating categories, images, and annotations with adjusted ids
